description: This file defines functions and types for rendering tables in terminal output, including border resolution, line wrapping with ANSI support, and dynamic column width calculation.

classes.name: TableColumn
classes.description: Defines properties for a table column, including key, header, alignment, width constraints, and flexibility.

classes.name: RenderTableOptions
classes.description: Options for rendering a table, including columns, rows, width, padding, and border style.

methods.name: resolveDefaultBorder
methods.description: Determines default border style based on platform and environment variables.

methods.name: padCell
methods.description: Pads cell content according to alignment and width.

methods.name: wrapLine
methods.description: Wraps a line of text considering ANSI escape sequences, ensuring proper line breaking without breaking escape sequences.

methods.name: normalizeWidth
methods.description: Normalizes width input to a valid integer or undefined.

methods.name: getTerminalTableWidth
methods.description: Returns the current terminal width or a fallback value.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders a table as a string with borders, headers, and rows, adjusting column widths dynamically.
